text: claims_detail_gold is the one table with real patient risk. This video designs exactly who can see what in it, before a single CREATE FUNCTION statement runs.
Three Unity Catalog groups: compliance_team sees every clinic unmasked, while clinical_quality and billing_analysts are both restricted to their own clinics with patient identity masked.
The row filter checks group membership first, then looks up the querying user against a clinic_access_map table -- never a hardcoded clinic list that goes stale.
The column masks are simpler: one group membership check decides whether patient_name and patient_ssn come through, or come through as NULL.
The access design is locked. Next: planning how claims data actually reaches this lakehouse every night, from 15 separate clinics.
